talk.jaymospowers.zfighter.story: Ask about the old story and any jobs
talk.jaymospowers.keeper.greet: "Welcome to the Lookout, traveller. The wind up here carries everything. What brings you?"
talk.jaymospowers.keeper.greet_blessed: "You carry my blessing still. Rest, train, and come back tomorrow for another."
talk.jaymospowers.hermit.greet: "Climbed all those rungs, did you? Ha! My knees gave up on that ladder years ago. I grow beans up here. Very good beans. Want some?"
talk.jaymospowers.hermit.poor: "%s emeralds, friend. Beans don't grow on trees. Well, mine grow on vines, but the point stands."
talk.jaymospowers.hermit.sold: "There you are: %s %s. Eat one when you're at your last breath, not before."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.greet.0: "Ah, a fighter who has broken through! Hold still, let me look at you. Yes... a fine frame, badly built. I could do better."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.greet.1: "Back already? Have you got my parts?"
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.greet.2: "The test, the test! My unit wants to see what you're made of."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.greet.3: "The unit is scrap and you are not. Splendid. The table is ready when you are."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.greet.4: "My finest work, walking about on its own! Any rattling? Any sparks? No? Splendid."
talk.jaymospowers.tinkerer.after: Ask how the work holds up
talk.jaymospowers.judge.greet: "Another one. Come closer, I don't bite. Not any more."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.ring: Ask about the tournament of the dead
talk.jaymospowers.judge.ring_how: "Ring the bell by the ring and the spirits of old fighters will come at you, one after another, %s in all. Beat them all and you are champion of the dead, and the fortune teller will send you back for nothing."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.ring_won: "You are already champion of the dead. The fortune teller owes you a ride home."
talk.jaymospowers.road_master.greet: "You walked the whole road? Then you have earned something. Sit."
talk.jaymospowers.road_master.greet_taug: "One lesson for each stay. Go and use it."
talk.jaymospowers.teller.alive: "You are not one of mine yet. Come back when you are dead."
talk.jaymospowers.teller.champion: "Champion of the dead! You don't have to pay me. Shall I send you back?"
talk.jaymospowers.teller.greet: "I can send you back to the living. Win the tournament of the dead and it costs nothing. Otherwise, %1$s emeralds, or %2$s TP of your training."
talk.jaymospowers.teller.paid: "You've paid me already. Shall I send you back?"
talk.jaymospowers.judge.reborn_ask: "Born again? Some do ask. You would not go back as you were: a new birth, a new childhood, a new road. Every road you or your company have walked open to you, and nothing of this life but what you carry. Well?"
talk.jaymospowers.afterlife.leave: "Now, how do you go back? As you were, to where you fell? Or born again, a new life from the first breath?"
talk.jaymospowers.afterlife.waking: The light lets you go. Before your eyes open, something asks: wake as you were, or begin again from the first breath?
talk.jaymospowers.demon_master.greet: "So you crawled down here for power. It will cost you blood. It always does."
talk.jaymospowers.demon_master.greet_tod: "You've bled enough today. Come back when the sky has turned."
talk.jaymospowers.demon_master.lesson: Ask for a lesson in blood
talk.jaymospowers.master.greet: "Ah, a young fighter. Have you come to learn, or to listen to an old man talk?"
talk.jaymospowers.master.greet_today: "Enough lessons for one day. But sit, if you want to talk."
talk.jaymospowers.master.no_spark: "No spark of ki in you, child. Come back when there is."
talk.jaymospowers.dark_master.greet: "You want what I know? Lessons here are paid in blood."
talk.jaymospowers.dark_master.no_spark: "No ki in you. You're not worth the lesson."
